zh: 2014 年，全球风电装机将近太阳能的两倍。
en: In 2014, the world had almost twice as much wind power as solar.

zh: 每一片是 10 GW，每一片黄铜是 100 GW。
en: Every plate is ten gigawatts. Every brass plate, one hundred.

zh: 风电一直在涨，太阳能涨得更快。
en: Wind kept growing. Solar grew faster.

zh: 仅 2025 一年，太阳能就新增了 500 多 GW。
en: In 2025 alone, solar added more than five hundred gigawatts.

zh: 退后一步，十二年合成一张表盘。
en: Step back, and twelve years become one dial.
Now it is the other way round.
